structure.layout: npm workspaces monorepo 'frisson' (private, ESM, node>=22.18, .nvmrc 22): packages/shared (@frisson/shared: zod schemas + sorting, exports ./src/index.ts and ./sorting, no build), apps/api (@frisson/api: Fastify 5 + better-sqlite3 + drizzle, run as native TS via node, no build), apps/web (@frisson/web: Vue 3 + Pinia + vue-router + Vite 6). Other: docs/ (SPEC, DEPLOY, adr/0001-0004; 0004 is user accounts), docker/Caddyfile, .github/{workflows/ci.yml,pull_request_template.md}, tsconfig.base.json, eslint.config.js, prettier.

app_ts_registration.entry: buildApp(opts: AppOptions) in apps/api/src/app.ts; returns un-started Fastify. AppOptions: dbPath, coversDir, auth {production, rateLimit {max,timeWindow}}, webDir.
app_ts_registration.setup: Fastify logger off when NODE_ENV=test; trustProxy from TRUST_PROXY=='true'; zod validator/serializer compilers.
order: authPlugin {production} (fastify-plugin; registers @fastify/cookie, decorateRequest 'user', decorate 'auth' with set/clearSessionCookie, onRequest hook resolves cookie frisson_session -> req.user via findSessionUser; must follow dbPlugin)
authRoutes prefix /api {rateLimit} (registers @fastify/rate-limit internally; POST /auth/signup, POST /auth/login presumably, POST /auth/logout, GET /auth/me)
webPlugin {dir: webDir ?? WEB_DIR} (last; static + SPA catch-all)
app_ts_registration.server_ts: calls buildApp then bootstrapFromEnv(app.db, process.env, app.log) (ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD first-admin creation).

structure.docker: Dockerfile multi-stage on node:22-bookworm-slim: manifests -> web-build (npm ci, npm run build -w apps/web) -> api-deps (npm ci --omit=dev -w apps/api) -> runtime (NODE_ENV=production, DATA_DIR=/data, WEB_DIR=/app/apps/web/dist, user node, HEALTHCHECK /api/health, CMD node apps/api/src/server.ts). compose.yaml: app (requires ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env; TRUST_PROXY=true; volume crate-data) + caddy:2 (docker/Caddyfile, 80/443). .dockerignore present.
structure.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml on pull_request and push to main. Job 'check': checkout, setup-node (.nvmrc, npm cache), npm ci, format:check, lint, typecheck, test, build. Job 'docker': buildx build image frisson:ci, run with ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD, poll /api/health and check '/' contains <div id="app">.

tests.runners: vitest ^3.2 in both apps (script 'vitest run'). shared package has no tests and no test script.

api.config: no vitest config file in apps/api (defaults). Tests in apps/api/test/*.test.ts: crates, migration, ownership, schema, auth-accounts, covers, shared-auth, web, albums, bootstrap, sorting, passwords, health. tsconfig includes src and test.

helpers.buildTestApp(opts?): buildApp with dbPath ':memory:', temp covers dir (mkdtemp, removed in onClose unless opts.coversDir given), auth {production:false, rateLimit {max:10000,timeWindow:60000}} overridable. Caller must app.close().
helpers.SignedIn: { user: PublicUser, cookie: string, headers: {cookie} } ; cookie is 'frisson_session=<token>' (SESSION_COOKIE)
helpers.signUp(app, overrides?): real POST /api/auth/signup with unique email/username (pid-counter) and password 'test-password-123'; expects 201; reads session cookie from response; returns SignedIn for a regular user.
helpers.createAdmin(app, overrides?): inserts admin directly via createUser(app.db, signup, 'admin') (displayName 'Admin') and createSession(app.db, user.id); returns SignedIn. Signup cannot create admins.
helpers.addCrate(app, name?, sortOrder?, ownerId: inserts crate straight into db; ownerId null = legacy crate (admin-only).

api.usage: app.inject({method,url,headers: user.headers, payload}); no real port opened.

web.config: test block inside apps/web/vite.config.ts: environment 'happy-dom'; no setupFiles, no separate vitest config. @vue/test-utils used. Tests colocated as *.test.ts beside source (viewTransitions, CrateBox, editControls, useCrateFlip, useAlbumSearch, permissions, redirect, crateLayout, tracks, session store, library store, TrackList, RecordStage, TrackEditor, CoverUpload, albumForm).

root_commands.test: npm test  (npm run test --workspaces --if-present => api + web vitest run)
root_commands.single_workspace: npm test -w apps/api ; npm test -w apps/web
root_commands.typecheck: npm run typecheck (api tsc, web vue-tsc, shared tsc)
root_commands.build: npm run build (only web has a build script)

conventions.format: Prettier: no semi, single quotes, width 100, trailingComma all. EditorConfig 2-space LF. ESLint 9 flat (vue essential + vue-ts recommended + prettier skip-formatting). Scripts: lint, format, format:check, typecheck, test, build.
conventions.naming: Scope @frisson/*, .ts extensions in imports. Plugins export xPlugin, routes xRoutes (FastifyPluginAsyncZod), services are plain functions taking (db, user?, input). Web: PascalCase .vue, one api/*.ts file per resource.
conventions.routes: Thin: zod schema {params, body, response}, call service with app.db, req.user, req.body. Reads public; writes pass req.user to service. 201 via reply.code(201).send, 204 on delete. Registered in app.ts under /api.
conventions.permissions: apps/api/src/services/permissions.ts: requireUser (401), canEditOwner, assertCanEditCrate (401/404/403), assertCanEditAlbum. Rule: admin edits all, owner edits own crates and their albums, ownerless crates admin-only. Services call these; routes never decide. Web mirror: apps/web/src/utils/permissions.ts canEditCrate (UI only).
conventions.authPlugin: plugins/auth.ts decorates request.user (PublicUser|null) and app.auth cookie helpers; onRequest hook looks up session cookie frisson_session (opaque token, hash stored). Must register after dbPlugin.
conventions.errors: errors.ts HttpError(statusCode,message), notFound(what), badRequest(msg). error-handler plugin emits {statusCode,error,message,issues?} (ApiError in shared): zod 400 with issues, response-serialization 500, HttpError, fastify 4xx, else 500.
conventions.shared: packages/shared/src/index.ts: zod 4; xInput for requests, plain names for responses, z.infer types, CreateXRequest = z.input. publicUser {id,email,username,displayName,role} (email present, so not for other users). Crate response carries ownerId/ownerUsername/ownerDisplayName (marked PUBLIC, never email). sorting.ts exported separately without zod.
conventions.dataClassification: Comment convention 'Data classification: PUBLIC|CONFIDENTIAL (PII)' on code handling user data (crates.ts service, session store, api/auth.ts).
conventions.web: Pinia setup stores (library, session) with ref/computed/functions, status idle|loading|ready|error; api/client.ts request<T>() with ApiRequestError and errorMessage(); api files wrap request with JSON.stringify bodies. Views are per route in router.ts; components grouped by feature dirs.
conventions.styling: Scoped <style> per component; global tokens in styles/base.css: --cardboard #c8a374, --cardboard-dark, --paper #f3ead8, --paper-dark, --ink #2b2118, --ink-soft, --marker-red, --ok-green, --star; --font-display Courier New monospace, --font-body system-ui. Square corners (border-radius 0), shared .btn (ink bg, paper text, Courier), .status-note, focus-visible red outline.
conventions.tests: API: vitest with buildTestApp helper (in-memory db, app.inject). Web: colocated *.test.ts.

documentation.profilesSocial: ABSENT. No grep hits for profile, social, follow, friend in README, SPEC, DEPLOY or ADRs. Closest: accounts/ownership (README Accounts, ADR 0004, SPEC section 8) and public owner fields on crates. ADR 0004 lists out of scope: email verification, password reset/change, OAuth, deleting users. No /signup-adjacent profile page or user routes exist in the API tables.
documentation.readme: Sections: Getting started, Scripts, Accounts, Environment variables, Database, API (full route table; says errors always {statusCode,error,message,issues?}), Layout, Deploying, Status ('through deployment done; next polish milestone 10'). Any new route needs a row in the API table and Layout mention.
documentation.spec: SPEC.md is the original plan: sections 1 Stack, 2 Repo structure, 3 Data model (Crate/Album/Track only, no User), 4 API (no auth routes), 5 UI, 6 Milestones 0-10, 7 Git workflow, 8 Self-hosting (later; mentions accounts in one sentence). Spec is stale relative to accounts: data model and API lack users and owner_id; no profiles/social milestone.
documentation.deploy: DEPLOY.md sections: try locally, server and domain, set up server, deploy, Updating (with 'Upgrading to user accounts'), Accounts, Backups, Restoring, Day to day, Hosting at home.
documentation.adrConvention: Files NNNN-slug.md with Status, Date, Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives considered. Next number is 0005. SPEC section 7 says significant decisions get an ADR. Git: Conventional Commits, squash-merge, PR template in .github.
